summary_md:
# #445 De bortglömda rapporterna

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-08-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

MarketMakers #445 (Niklas and Mange) follows up on companies the podcast covered earlier, in the middle of Q2 reporting season. The Stockholm index was down for a ninth straight day, and the hosts point out that reactions to reports depend on expectations: Fractal Gaming fell little after a very weak report, while EG7 fell after a strong one. The overall tone is constructive. Mange still holds NIAB and Munters and thinks both cases are intact. Niklas has trimmed Avarda Bank because he sees fair value, calls Pexip's defence-driven turnaround very attractive, and says the Xplora turnaround is over.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NIAB — NIAB | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Mange owns it. Strong Q2 (EBIT +45%), new high-margin contracts, more data-centre orders expected, EV/EBIT 10 vs. a fair level of ~15.

#### Reasoning

Host (Mange) sees a quality company with 40% insider ownership and ~20% organic growth since listing. It benefits from road and power-grid investment and data centres. Fund ownership is only 2.6%, which could create buying pressure if funds move in, and buybacks are possible. He sees ~50% upside to EV/EBIT 15, and more if the company reaches its 7.5% EBIT margin target. The weak consulting acquisition is a minor negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- consulting segment margin fails to improve in 2027
- data-centre order flow dries up
- further poorly performing acquisitions
- fund-ownership thesis proves wrong because funds dislike the company

> *"Jag tycker väl en mer rimlig värdering kanske är närmare 15, så 50 procent uppsida"*

---

### 🟡 MTRS — Munters | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Mange still holds despite component-shortage delays. Order intake up 137% and the CEO is confident about 2027. Sees 17-18% margins and EV/EBIT ~10 once the order book is delivered.

#### Reasoning

Host (Mange) thinks the case is intact. The component shortage only pushed deliveries back a quarter and customers are not unhappy. He expects margins above consensus (17-18% vs. 14-15%). If growth continues, the multiple could re-rate to 20-30x. Risks: the shortage lasts longer, the FoodTech sale is handled badly, and the stock is down 5-10% since he first covered it.

#### Sell Triggers

- component shortage continues beyond one quarter
- customers lose trust in delivery reliability
- data-centre capex slows

> *"Så jag är fortfarande kvar i aktien trots förseningen."*

---

### 🟡 TFBANK — Avarda Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Case has played out: EPS +30%, credit cards growing in Germany. Niklas has scaled down and sees fair value at P/E ~15, with risk now skewed to the downside.

#### Reasoning

Host (Niklas) still owns a small position. Growth is strong but he says visibility into Germany is poor and even a small slowdown could hit the stock hard. Valuation is fair at P/E 15 this year and 12-13 next year, with a 2.5% yield. He thinks it can keep working long term but does not expect much more in the near term.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit card growth in Germany slows
- loan losses grow faster than the loan book
- Everyday Finance margin expansion stalls

> *"Jag har skalat ner min position en hel del. Jag tycker att det är ganska fair värdering givet den här tillväxten men också de risker som finns."*

---

### 🟠 PEXIP — Pexip | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Niklas is 'very tempted' after the Q2 report: defence share of ARR doubled, NRR above 100%, EBITDA margin ~31%. Does not own it yet. P/E 24/20, yield above 5%.

#### Reasoning

Host (Niklas): the move to sovereign, self-hosted secure video for defence and government in Europe and the US, plus being the only Microsoft-certified Teams provider for US defence, makes customers sticky. The margin trend is strong. Valuation is 'half expensive' but reasonable for a fast-growing, profitable company. Mange adds that AI poses little threat because of security complexity and certifications.

#### Sell Triggers

- defence/government ARR growth slows
- NRR falls back below 100%
- loss of exclusive US certification

> *"Jag äger dock inte Pexip just nu men jag är väldigt sugen på det efter den här rapporten."*

---

### 🟠 EG7 — Enad Global 7 | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Strong report driven by Farfar West and My Singing Monsters, plus heavy insider buying. But the Alien game launch in 6 days carries release risk. Hosts do not own it.

#### Reasoning

Hosts note a solid revenue mix, with ~70% from the existing game catalogue, and aggressive insider buying (30+ this year). But the company depends on hit games, the stock often falls after big launches, and estimates vary widely (P/E 7-17). Niklas suggests watching insider trades after the Alien release as a signal.

#### Sell Triggers

- Alien game launch disappoints
- insiders start selling
- Daybreak margin does not rebound in Q3

> *"Börjar de sälja, då vet man att det inte går bra för det här alien spelet. Köper de ännu mer, ja då har det rullat på bra för alien."*

---

### ⛔ XPLRA — Xplora | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Down 26% on a weak report. The subscription strategy on Doro phones is taking too long and hosts say the turnaround is over. Cited investor Finans Amir sold.

#### Reasoning

Hosts: the Doro deal was a smart idea but subscription uptake is much slower than hoped, and last autumn's sales look like a one-off. 'When something takes longer than you think, it usually doesn't happen.' Well-known Twitter investor Finans Amir sold after the report (cited opinion, not the hosts').

#### Sell Triggers

- subscription revenue from Doro phones accelerates

> *"Så det var ju en smart tanke, men den här turnarounden är väl över nu, får man väl ändå säga, i Explora."*

---
